title: M2 Content and Route Contracts (Child 1 of Plan 03)

success_criteria.description: PageSchema and SettingsDataSchema validate real records and reject invalid ones at build time
success_criteria.verify: npm run check && npm test exit 0; schema validation tests pass

success_criteria.description: Single visibility-driven route resolver drives getStaticPaths, sitemap, and verifier; draft→no route, noindex→route+no discovery, public→route+discovery
success_criteria.verify: npm test exit 0; route-visibility tests pass for all three states

success_criteria.description: Phase-aware verifier accepts parameterized manifests; read-only; exits 0 on current empty-route build
success_criteria.verify: npm run verify exits 0; verifier tests pass

tasks.title: Content and settings schemas
tasks.end_state: PageSchema (frontmatter-only, extends RecordBase with title/description) and SettingsDataSchema (nav labels, site title, optional all-or-none contact block) are defined in a pure importable module; content.config.ts consumes them; page loader is .md-only; settings file envelope {"site": <SettingsData>} loads with entry ID 'site'.
verification: RED: node --test tests/policy.test.mjs — schema validation tests fail (stub accepts invalid records)
GREEN: npm run check exits 0; npm test exits 0; invalid page frontmatter and partial settings are rejected; valid records pass; entry ID 'site' resolves with correct data

tasks.title: Single route-visibility pipeline
tasks.end_state: A single resolver (site-routes.ts) maps page records to route/visibility tuples consumed by getStaticPaths, sitemap, and verifier. src/config/site.ts owns page IDs, paths, and nav order. ROUTES stays empty (root is code-owned noindex, activated in Child 2). The M1 sitemap endpoint consumes the resolver instead of hardcoding every ROUTES entry as public.
verification: RED: node --test tests/policy.test.mjs — route-visibility tests fail (stub returns draft routes or includes noindex in discovery)
GREEN: npm run check exits 0; npm test exits 0; npm run build exits 0; draft→no route, noindex→route excluded from sitemap, public→route in sitemap; M1 output unchanged (empty sitemap, empty routes)

tasks.title: Phase-aware output verifier
tasks.end_state: verifyBuild accepts a parameterized manifest with expectedHtmlRoutes, expectedDiscoverableRoutes, expectedFileEndpoints, allowEmptySitemap, and a narrow _astro/ asset allowlist. Sitemap URL sets are compared in both directions (no missing public route). The CLI entry stays M1-compatible (empty HTML routes). Read-only.
verification: RED: node --test tests/policy.test.mjs — verifier tests fail (stub returns ok:true for missing sitemap URL, unexpected noindex, and unexpected asset type)

GREEN: npm run check exits 0; npm test exits 0; npm run build exits 0; npm run verify exits 0; verifier rejects missing/duplicate/wrong-origin canonicals, draft/noindex sitemap leaks, unexpected routes, endpoint mismatches, and disallowed _astro/ asset types; read-only snapshot test passes
